data.long_meaning: The name Peeyush is derived from the Sanskrit word 'pee' which means prosperity and 'yush' which means success, happiness. This name is believed to bring prosperity, success and happiness to the child. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Peeyush usually hope their child will grow to embody prosperity, success, happiness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
